phase3_descope_reason: SPEC.md assumed 'reuse short_rth_pure_flip_prediction_enriched machinery verbatim, mirrored' for the long-model population. Scouting the actual implementation before writing code found the bearish-flip model's population traces to short_rth_entry_surface_backfill/entry_surface.py:69-71, which drops every direction==-1 (bearish) regime at the first funnel stage for all 6 years -- no bearish-regime checkpoint population exists anywhere in the repo. Correct mirroring requires a new entry_surface build + full 695-feature re-attachment + fresh labeling + fresh GBT retrain across 6 years, i.e. rebuilding three prior studies' pipelines mirrored, not a quick reuse. User decision 2026-07-20: stop after Phase 2; defer Phase 3 to a separately-briefed future study.
